**Checklist**

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A line in CHANGELOG.md under the unreleased version, for a user-visible change
- [ ] Docs updated (README, SKILL.md, GUIDE.md, AGENT-API.md) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No keys, keypair files, API keys or RPC URLs with keys
